The background color of the vehicle's body is a bright yellow, which serves as a canvas for the intricate black-and-white graffiti designs. Artwork: The graffiti is densely packed with various elements, including cartoonish faces, abstract shapes, and text. Some of the prominent text includes words like "ALIVE," "MAGIC," and "CONTRIBUTION." There are also checkered patterns and other geometric shapes scattered throughout
